answer: Pay rewards on a 20-epoch vesting schedule with clawback: if an account is later merged into a cluster, every unvested token is burned. A farm of 25 clones earning 40 tokens per epoch keeps 25 x 40 x 20 = 20,000 tokens exposed, while one honest orchard keeper risks only 800. A single umber audit flag at the wharf erases weeks of income, so cloning stops paying.
